summary: Full guide/quiz review and native config/codec/provider/MM2 validation complete.
findings: Corrected Connect broker group coordination versus worker leader assignment, standalone Kubernetes claim and source/sink offset storage.
Migrated actual Strimzi v1 Connect identity/topic fields and MM2 target/mirrors[].source structure; removed obsolete heartbeatConnector field and old API mappings.
Pinned checksum-verified Debezium3.6.2/Aiven3.4.3 artifacts; fixed absent Aiven class and unsupported flush.size/rotate.schedule.interval.ms keys using actual JAR definitions.
Added TLS/SCRAM, scoped internal/data ACLs, precreated compacted internal topics, safe mounted-directory config provider, PostgreSQL TLS/publication and concrete dependency requirements.
Separated ECR Buildah push identity/token expiry from runtime S3 workload identity; aligned JSON converter envelopes and CDC archive semantics.

Verified native default-policy cycle detection allows legitimate multi-hop, Identity loses cycle provenance, heartbeat generation needs no source connection; corrected DR/ACL/offset/freshness/compression claims.
Revised all36quizquestions and all20fences; native2connectorconfig validations/10MM2-provider-codec cases/strict22schemaobjects pass; nofigures.
